plain_english: With one short — by the pure, by the chief — mutual fitness would be of the secondary — as the king's man, and the brahmin's.
sanskrit_cite: ekahānyā pradhānena śuddhenānyānyayogitā syādguṇasya yathā rājñaḥ puruṣo brāhmaṇasya ca

plain_english: So by another chief — what other unity, or by still another — relation-called of the secondary would be — as the king's horse, man.
sanskrit_cite: tathānyena pradhānena yaikatānyāpareṇa vā saṃbandhākhyā guṇasya syādrājño'śvaḥ puruṣo

plain_english: Thus relation's course told: resting-on-Māyā-knowers — intellects of varied-thing-views, transaction-causing.
sanskrit_cite: iti saṃbandhagatyuktā māyīyajñātṛniṣṭhitāḥ dhiyo vibhinnārthadṛśo vyavahārapravartikāḥ

plain_english: Not — but those, though called so erred — all even — moment by moment grounded in endless-awareness reflection called self-awareness.
sanskrit_cite: na paraṃ tāstathā bhrāntāḥ sarvā api pratikṣaṇāt svasaṃvitsaṃjñakānantacidvimarśapratiṣṭhitāḥ

plain_english: Told, self-awareness-proved, this: unrefuted, useful — relation in recognition — full apparatus besides.
sanskrit_cite: uktaḥ svasaṃvitsiddho'yaṃ nirbādha upayogavān saṃbandhaḥ pratyabhijñāyāṃ pūrṇaḥ parikaraḥ punaḥ
